name: writer-agent
description: 写作 Agent：DSH 插件，一个入口两种写作模式（今日头条 / 番茄长篇）+ 写作台

scripts.test:node: npm run build && node scripts/build-bundle.mjs && node --test --import ./test/setup.mjs test/*.test.mjs test/engine/*.test.mjs
scripts.test: npm run guard && npm run test:py && npm run test:node
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:dsh && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:e2e:fanqie
